content: openpi ships built-in LIBERO configs: pi0_libero (loads gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_base/params) and pi0_fast_libero (loads gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_fast_base/params). Checkpoints auto-download from gs://openpi-assets to ~/.cache/openpi (override via OPENPI_DATA_HOME). pi0 is 3.3B params (PaliGemma 3B backbone + ~300M action expert) -- bf16 footprint ~6.6GB, fits T4 16GB for inference.
